# VulnSig

> VulnSig encodes CVSS metrics into a compact visual glyph. Each shape, characteristic, and color maps to a specific metric: attack vector, complexity, privileges; impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability; scope change, and more. VulnSig supports CVSS 4.0, 3.1, 3.0, and 2.0, and is available as a REST API (SVG and PNG), TypeScript, Python, and Rust libraries, and a React component.

While a CVSS vector provides rich information, many applications only report the CVSS score. VulnSig makes vulnerability characteristics beyond severity immediately legible. Glyphs are rendered from a CVSS vector string such as `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`; the score is calculated from the vector unless provided.

## REST API

Both endpoints are `GET` requests that return an image (cached as immutable). Errors return HTTP 400 with JSON: `{ "error": "Invalid CVSS vector", "detail": "..." }`.

- `https://vulnsig.io/api/svg`: returns `image/svg+xml`
- `https://vulnsig.io/api/png`: returns `image/png`

Query parameters:

- `vector` (required): CVSS 4.0, 3.x, or 2.0 vector string, percent-encoded or in compact form (see below)
- `size` (optional): rendered size in pixels, 16 to 1024 (default: 120)
- `score` (optional): override the calculated score, 0 to 10
- `density` (optional, PNG only): render density in DPI, 72 to 600 (default: 72)

Compact vector form avoids percent-encoding: replace `:` with `.` and `/` with `-`. For example, `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L` becomes `CVSS.3.1-AV.N-AC.L`.

Examples:

```html
<img src="https://vulnsig.io/api/svg?vector=CVSS.3.1-AV.N-AC.L-PR.N-UI.N-S.U-C.H-I.H-A.H" />
```

```markdown
![vulnsig](https://vulnsig.io/api/png?vector=CVSS.3.1-AV.N-AC.L-PR.N-UI.N-S.U-C.H-I.H-A.H&size=64)
```

```bash
curl "https://vulnsig.io/api/svg?vector=CVSS.3.1-AV.N-AC.L-PR.N-UI.N-S.U-C.H-I.H-A.H" -o glyph.svg
```

## Libraries

TypeScript (`npm install vulnsig`):

```ts
import { renderGlyph } from "vulnsig";

const svg = renderGlyph({
  vector: "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H",
  size: 120,
});
// svg is an SVG string
```

React (`npm install vulnsig-react`):

```tsx
import { VulnSig } from "vulnsig-react";

<VulnSig
  vector="CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H"
  size={120}
  score={9.8} // optional; calculated if omitted
/>;
```

Python (`pip install vulnsig`):

```python
from vulnsig import render_glyph

svg = render_glyph(
    vector="CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H",
    size=120,
)
```

Rust (`cargo add vulnsig`):

```rust
use vulnsig::render_glyph;

let svg = render_glyph(
    "CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H",
    None,      // score: calculated if None
    Some(120), // size in pixels
);
```

## Source and packages

- [vulnsig-ts](https://github.com/vulnsig/vulnsig-ts): TypeScript library source
- [vulnsig-react](https://github.com/vulnsig/vulnsig-react): React component source
- [vulnsig-py](https://github.com/vulnsig/vulnsig-py): Python library source
- [vulnsig-rs](https://github.com/vulnsig/vulnsig-rs): Rust library source
- [npm: vulnsig](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vulnsig)
- [npm: vulnsig-react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vulnsig-react)
- [PyPI: vulnsig](https://pypi.org/project/vulnsig)
- [crates.io: vulnsig](https://crates.io/crates/vulnsig)

## Site

- [Recent CVEs](https://vulnsig.io/): glyphs for recently published CVEs
- [Known exploited vulnerabilities](https://vulnsig.io/?tab=kevs): glyphs for recent CISA KEV entries
- [Search](https://vulnsig.io/?tab=search): search CVEs by product or ID
- [Gallery](https://vulnsig.io/?tab=gallery): glyphs for well-known vulnerabilities
- [Legend](https://vulnsig.io/?tab=legend): how each CVSS metric maps to the glyph
- [Tools](https://vulnsig.io/?tab=tools): API and library usage
- [About](https://vulnsig.io/?tab=about): background on VulnSig and CVSS
- CVE pages: `https://vulnsig.io/cve/{CVE-ID}` (for example, `https://vulnsig.io/cve/CVE-2021-44228`) shows the glyph, score, and description for a CVE
- Any vector: `https://vulnsig.io/?vector={compact-vector}` loads a vector into the glyph builder

## Optional

- [CVSS (FIRST)](https://www.first.org/cvss/): the CVSS specification and calculator
